doc_layout.CHANGELOG.md: Project changelog, unreleased section at top
doc_layout.changelog.d/: Changelog fragment directory, one .misc.md file per change
doc_layout.src/robotsix_chat/repo/direct/__init__.p: Direct-repo tool factory (push, PR, direct_fix). Tools are nested async functions inside build_direct_repo_tools(). Entry point: build_direct_repo_tools(settings, component_request=None).
doc_layout.src/robotsix_chat/repo/study/workspace.p: WorkspaceManager class for tarball-based repo study (no git binary). Entry point: build_repo_study_tools(settings, direct_repo_settings). URL-building for tarball downloads at line ~152.
doc_layout.src/robotsix_chat/chat/server/app.py: Starlette ASGI app. _build_static_tools() at line ~582 assembles all tool lists.
doc_layout.docs/periodic-checks.md: User-facing docs for periodic subsessions (monitors). Documents the blocked-resume threshold detection (item 8 under 'How it works under the hood'): 3 consecutive blocked resumes auto-close with repeated_blocked reason. Also documents auto-stop and failure notifications: the assistant immediately notifies the user when a monitor auto-stops or fails, with a fallback agent_message frame if the LLM call fails.
doc_layout.docs/notification/skill.md: User-facing docs for the notify_user tool. Includes delivery limitations and fallback agent_message delivery for background task failures.
doc_layout.src/robotsix_chat/notification/skill.md: Source-level skill document for the notify_user tool, loaded into the agent's context. Mirrors docs/notification/skill.md.
doc_layout.docs/architecture.md: Architecture docs — subpackage inventory mentions blocked-resume threshold in the subsessions/ row.
doc_layout.docs/chat/server.md: Auto-generated mkdocstrings stub for robotsix_chat.chat.server module.
doc_layout.docs/chat/server/routes/admin.md: New doc page for admin routes (disk monitoring + emergency prune). Added for disk-full resilience feature.
doc_layout.mkdocs.yml: MkDocs config with nav including API Reference section. New entry added at 'robotsix_chat.chat.server.routes.admin: chat/server/routes/admin.md'.
doc_layout.src/robotsix_chat/chat/server/routes/adm: Admin endpoints — GET /admin/disk (shutil.disk_usage, no disk writes) and POST /admin/prune (calls _evict_overflow on conversation_store, prune_terminal on subsession_registry, _clear_degraded on memory backend). Returns JSON with cleaned/skipped/errors lists.

conventions.changelog: CHANGELOG.md has unreleased section at top; changes listed as markdown bullets.
conventions.changelog_fragments: Each PR adds a fragment under changelog.d/ with pattern YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ-<description>-<random>.misc.md containing a single-line description.
conventions.error_format: Tool error strings start with 'Error:' or 'Refused:' — no trailing punctuation after 'Refused:' lines.
